CustomField.label: Header Style
CustomField.description: #733: how the page header is laid out: classic (icon, title and subtitle), classicSpread (the same, spread across the width) or hero (Stacked: eyebrow, pretitle, large title, body, tags and footer). Card and Title on Border are section styles and are not offered for a page.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Classic, Classic Spread or Stacked. Stacked adds a pretitle, body, tags and footer.
